verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of choosing a storage or compute region, or of data-residency controls. The documented search filters cover GPU type, RAM, CPU and bandwidth, and Secure Cloud verifies datacenter certification (Tier 2/3, ISO 27001), not geography. A community report of a host misrepresenting its location suggests listings show location, but that is not a documented residency capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
